department: The Edward S. Rogers Sr. Department of Electrical & Computer Engineering

deadline.value: MASc and PhD applications (including two references) close January 7, 2027 for September 2027 or January 2028 start. Apply through both the SGS and ECE application systems.
deadline.quote: MASc and PhD Programs | Application deadline for Fall / Winter start (September 2027/ January 2028) | January 7, 2027

gre_subject.value: No GRE requirement is mentioned on the ECE admissions pages.

supervisor.value: No supervisor is needed if you apply before the deadline, but contacting professors can strengthen your application; the SGS summary says a supervisor is identified before admission.
supervisor.quote: If you are applying to either the MASc or PhD programs prior to the deadline, you are not required to find a supervisor. | You are welcome to contact potential professors, as this can strengthen your application

funding.value: All PhD students in good standing get a guaranteed funding package: 4 years (5 for direct-entry PhD).
funding.quote: all MASc & PhD students who are in good standing, and who are making satisfactory progress toward the completion of their degree, are guaranteed a funding package for a set period of registration. | 4 years for PhD students | 5 years for direct-entry PhD students.

entry_route.value: PhD normally follows a thesis MASc (B+); bachelor's holders with an A- average can be considered for direct-entry PhD by applying to the MASc and discussing it with supervisors.
entry_route.quote: An applicant interested in direct-entry to the PhD program should submit an MASc application and then discuss their desired academic path with potential supervisors. A minimum overall average equivalent to at least A-

english_waiver.value: India is not on ECE's exempt list, so an English-taught degree needs official verification: a transcript note or a statement from your university sent to ECE.
english_waiver.quote: If the degree was completed in a country not on the above list, the language of instruction and examination will require official verification. | Official verification is usually provided in the form of a note on the transcript confirming the use of English as the language of instruction and examination.

notes: Two references required. Separate ECE Application System in addition to SGS.
